items.q: There were three musicians there; Harry Swanagan, Baby Lovett and Roland Bruce, who was a great violinist.

ctx.x: The one that burned down and Lovett almost lost his life in this particular theater. There were three musicians there; Harry Swanagan, Baby Lovett and Roland Bruce, who was a great violinist. Harry Swanagan was a great
pianist and the three of them were working in this theater when this explosion came but --
